name: transmission-tracker-add
description: tracker-add Get more trackers, get more seeders, get more peers for transmission See no peers,seeds for some torrent(s)? Add more tracker(s) for Transmission This script automatically checks new torrents and adds trackers

variables.name: HOSTPORT
variables.description: Transmission hostname/container name/IP address with connection port

variables.name: TR_AUTH
variables.description: Authentication data for the Transmission host set in variable HOSTPORT. Use user:pass style for the entry

variables.name: TORRENTLIST
variables.description: Torrent tracker list to add to all torrents in the host set in HOSTPORT
